title: Intrinsic completeness under the normalized residue coefficient equivalence
statement: Let S be a scheme, ell prime, and E/Q_ell a finite extension. Let d be an adic datum on O_E whose ideal is generated by the singleton recorded uniformizer tuple, with the supplied equation ha. Let c be an IntegralResidueCoefficientModel on S [lem-weil-pbc-integral-residue-coefficient-model]. If K in PbcCompletedDerived S (pbcIntegralDatum ell E) is intrinsically complete [lem-weil-pbc-integral-coefficient-completeness-transport], restriction along the inverse of purCoefficientIso followed by c.completed inverse is complete for the actual completed-adic singleton Koszul unit. No scheme map, residue chart, or covering is assumed.

from.place: The integral-lattice step: normalize the completed coefficients and residue models on the fixed stratum before applying the perfect residue lifting theorem.

lean.statement:
theorem integralResidueCoefficient_complete
    (S : Scheme.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (d : AdicCoefficientDatum (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E))
    (ha : Ideal.span (Set.range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦
      Padic.coefficientExtensionUniformizer l E)) = d.ideal)
    (c : IntegralResidueCoefficientModel l E d S)
    (K : PbcCompletedDerived S (pbcIntegralDatum l E))
    (hK : PbcIsIntrinsicallyComplete S (pbcIntegralDatum l E) K) :
    IsCompletedAdicDerivedComplete S d 1
      (fun _ ↦ Padic.coefficientExtensionUniformizer l E) ha
      ((pbcDerivedRestrict (purCoefficientIso l E S ≪≫ c.completed.symm).inv).obj K)
